title: SCA outputs.json (K1)
description: out/outputs.json of every `sca` and `sca-notifier` command: the values an adapter reads in place of GITHUB_OUTPUT. Written whenever the output directory is writable, also on failure.

status.description: ok = exit 0; failed_targets = exit 0 (merge only), outputs complete; error = exit 1 or 2, outputs may be partial.

engine.description: Engine or notifier ref that ran.

message.description: Error text when status is error.

outputs.description: Named values of the command (K1, section 4). Keys keep the names of today's action outputs (matrix, targets-file, failed-count).
